models.name: Guardian 9–22 kW
models.notes: 10000006541 Rev E never mentions 178/183; only N1/N2/T1/23/194

gotchas: TX ATS p.16: "closure of Wire J3:8 and J3:9 circuit by switch circuit action must result in generator engine cranking and startup" — the ATS side is a Form C dry contact, so the generator input is the only source of voltage.
EcoGen p.34: open the "remote two-wire start test switch" and "In approximately one minute the generator will automatically shut down" — a cool-down, not an instant stop.
Neither document states voltage or current on 178/183. Fail-safe note from TX p.16: with the ATS unpowered "the 2-wire start system is active (closed)" — an ATS sends *run* on loss of its own power.
